content.intro: This lesson covers Slices and Borrowed Views of Data. It sits in Module 6, Ownership and Borrowing, and builds toward a practical Rust mental model rather than memorizing a term in isolation.
content.why_it_matters: Slices and Borrowed Views of Data matters when you work with value ownership and reference validity. Understanding the rule helps you predict compiler or runtime behavior, document assumptions, and choose a safer implementation when inputs or system conditions change.
